column1: # The label wire surface of the retired server, the old backlog. No section
# Columns: case, caller, method, path, request keys, status, set-cookie,
# response body key paths. A key path collapses an array to []. A cell of -
# means the column does not apply, and a body of - is an empty body.
# Read from a run, not from the source, on the same binary and the same
# 2026-08-29 session as legacy-account-surface.tsv, with one simulated CORE One
# dialled in so the printer paths have a printer to name.
#   Two labels may carry the same name. POST /api/labels answers 201 twice for
#   the name bench and the listing then holds both.
#   PUT /api/printers/{id}/labels replaces the whole set. Assigning an id no
#   label has answers 204 and leaves the printer with nothing.
#   PUT /api/printers/{unknown}/labels answers 204. A printer that does not
#   GET /api/printers answers a labels array that is empty for a printer whose
#   own /labels path lists one. The listing does not carry the assignment.
#   answers 404. The two disagree about what a missing label is.
#   An empty name is refused with the validator's own sentence in the body:
#   "Key: 'Name' Error:Field validation for 'Name' failed on the 'required' tag".
# The store behind this is printer_labels and printer_label_assignments in
# ./data/state.db. The schema is in earlier research.
